title: Explain SOLID principles with examples.
description: SOLID: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency In

data.text: SOLID: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion. Each promotes maintainable, extensible code.
SRP: One reason to change. OCP: Open for extension, closed for modification. LSP: Subtypes must be substitutable. ISP: Small focused interfaces. DIP: Depend on abstractions.
